name: POST /api/admin/accounts/:id/trial - Grant a time-limited trial
description: Starts a trial of a paid plan with an explicit expiry. MUTATING, so the Authorization header carries the step-up token. Sets subscriptions.status to 'trialing' (already permitted by the existing status CHECK) and trial_ends_at, and applies the trial plan's document limit immediately. The daily expiry job reverts the account to free once trial_ends_at passes. Rejected when the account already has a live paid Stripe subscription — trialing a plan they already pay for would downgrade them on expiry.

statusTransitions.trialing -> active (free): DELETE /api/admin/accounts/:id/trial, or automatically once trial_ends_at passes
statusTransitions.trialing -> active (paid): Stripe checkout completing during the trial

errorCases.when: The :id path parameter is not a valid UUID

errorCases.message: plan must be one of solo, team, scale
errorCases.when: plan is missing, unrecognised, or 'free' (trialling free is meaningless)

errorCases.message: duration_days must be a whole number between 1 and 180
errorCases.when: duration_days is absent, non-integer, below 1 or above 180

errorCases.message: A reason is required and is recorded in the audit log
Step-up verification required for this action
errorCases.when: The Authorization header carries a plain admin session token rather than an elevated step-up token
No account exists with that id

errorCases.message: This account already has an active paid subscription, so a trial would downgrade it on expiry
errorCases.when: The account has a live Stripe subscription with status active
